questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule /Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Square : Four :: ?
questions.solution:
Logic is** "Shape : Number of sides**". 

**Square : Four **⇒ A square is a shape that has four sides.

Similarily,

**Rectangle : Four** ⇒ A rectangle is a shape that also has four sides.

Therefore, **"Rectangle : Four"** follows the same relationship.

**As for the other options:**

__
 
• "Six : Hexagon" and "Five : Pentagon" also relate their number of sides to shape, **So, these two options are wrong as they follow a reverse relationship.__**
 
• "Triangle : Five" is incorrect because a triangle has three sides, not five.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Rectangle : Four".**

questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs and two numbers (Not digits) the equation will be correct?

9 ÷ 3 + 7 × 4 – 5 = 20
questions.solution:
Given equation: 9 ÷ 3 + 7 × 4 – 5 = 20.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) ÷ and –, 5 and 4

Given: 9 ÷ 3 + 7 × 4 – 5 = 20

After interchanging the numbers and signs we get;

⇒ 9 - 3 + 7 × __**5 ÷ 4**__ = 20

⇒ 9 - 3 + __**7 × 1.25**__ = 20

⇒ __**9**__ - 3 __**+ 8.75**__ = 20

⇒ __17.75 - 3__ = 20

⇒ - 14.75 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) × and –, 3 and 5

Given: 9 ÷ 3 + 7 × 4 – 5 = 20

After interchanging the numbers and signs we get;

⇒ __**9 ÷ 5**__ + 7 - 4 × 3 = 20

⇒ 1.8 + 7 - __**4 × 3**__ = 20

⇒ __**1.8 + 7**__ - 12 = 20

⇒ __8.8 - 12__ = 20

⇒ - 3.2 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 3) + and ×, 9 and 7**

Given: 9 ÷ 3 + 7 × 4 – 5 = 20

After interchanging the numbers and signs we get;

⇒ __**7**____** ÷ 3 × 9**__ + 4 – 5 = 20

⇒ __**21 + 4**__ – 5 = 20

⇒ __25 - 5__ = 20

⇒** 20 = 20**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 4) ÷ and –, 7 and 5

Given: 9 ÷ 3 + 7 × 4 – 5 = 20

After interchanging the numbers and signs we get;

⇒ 9 - 3 + 7 × __**4 ÷ 5**__ = 20

⇒ 9 - 3 + __**7 × **__**__0.8__** = 20

⇒ __**9**__ - 3 __**+ **5.6__ = 20

⇒ __14.6 - 3__ = 20

⇒ 11.6 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Which among the following is a river that originates in the Western Ghats?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandovi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Mandovi River-**

__
 
• It originates from a cluster of 30 springs at Bhimgad in the **Western Ghats** in the Belagavi district of **Karnataka**.
 
• The river has a total catchment area of 2032 sq km, of which 1580 sq km lies in Goa.
 
• **Panaji** is situated on the banks of the river Mandovi.
 
• **Dudhsagar Falls **in Goa are also formed by this river.
 
• The river passes through Karnataka and Goa before it empties into the **Arabian Sea.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Narmada River-**

• Narmada is the longest river in MP and the **5th largest river** in the country.
 
• Narmada is also the largest **west**-flowing river in India.
 
• The total length of Narmada is **1312 km **and its total length in Madhya Pradesh is **1077 km.**
 
• Narmada does not form a delta, it forms an **estuary.**

**Luni River-**

 
• Luni River originates from Nag Pahar or **Naga hills** in the **Ajmer** district of **Rajasthan**.
 
• Luni originates in the Pushkar valley of the **Aravalli Range,** near Ajmer, and passes through the southeastern portion of the Thar Desert.
 
• It ends in the marshy lands of **Rann of** **Kutch** in **Gujarat**.
 
• **Jaswant Sagar Dam** was built in **1892** by Maharaja Jaswant Singh. It is one of the largest artificial lakes in India.

**Banas River-**

 
• Banas River originates from Khamnor Hills of **Aravalli Range,** near Kumbhalgarh in Rajsamand, **Rajasthan**.
 
• Banas River is a tributary of the **Chambal River** and it is approximately **512** kilometers in length.
 
• This river is also called** ‘Van Ki Asha‘.**

questions.question: Which among the following is not a type of Right to freedom in the Indian constitution?

options.text: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, etc.

questions.solution:

• Right to Freedom

 
 
• The objective of the Indian Constitution is to ensure freedom of thought, expression, belief, religion, and worship. Therefore, the Right to Freedom has been mentioned in the Indian Constitution from Articles 19 to 22.
 
• In these, provisions have been given keeping in mind all the sections of the people of the country, so that any person can do any work of his mind, but that work should not be illegal and unconstitutional, nor should that work be done by any other person such that the fundamental rights should be violated.
 
• Article 19 of the Indian Constitution is most important in this regard. Article 19 of the Indian Constitution at present describes only 6 freedoms for the citizens of the country, which are as follows
 
 
• Freedom of thought and expression
 
• Freedom of arms and peaceful assembly.
 
• Community and freedom of association
 
• Freedom of travel
 
• Freedom of residence
 
• Freedom of trade (Hence option 1 is correct)
 
 
 
• Article 20 offers protection in respect of conviction for offences. **(Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
• Article 21 offers protection of life and personal liberty. **(Hence option 2 is correct)**
 
• Article 22 offers protection against arrest and detention in certain cases.

questions.question: If the diagonals of a rhombus are 10 cm and 24 cm, then what is the perimeter of the rhombus?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The side of a rhombus is the hypotenuse of a right triangle formed by half of its diagonals.

Side = √((d₁ ÷ 2)² + (d₂ ÷ 2)²)

⇒ Side = √(12² + 5²) = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13 cm

Perimeter = 4 × Side = 4 × 13 = 52 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 52 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first diagonal (AC) = 24 cm

Length of second diagonal (BD) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles (90°).

By Pythagoras theorem: Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

Perimeter of a rhombus = 4 × side

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/906a57d5508fcceb8742c10902feb956681acd374d795c10645d487ad944784f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Half of diagonal AC (OA) = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm

⇒ Half of diagonal BD (OB) = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm

⇒ In right-angled ΔAOB, the intersection at center O forms a 90° angle.

⇒ Applying Pythagoras theorem in ΔAOB:

⇒ AB² = OA² + OB²

⇒ a² = 12² + 5²

⇒ a² = 144 + 25

⇒ a² = 169

⇒ a = √169 = 13 cm

⇒ The perimeter of the rhombus = 4 × a

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × 13 = 52 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 52 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Formula for Perimeter

The perimeter of a rhombus can be calculated directly from its diagonals using the formula: P = 2 × √(d₁² + d₂²).

Area of Rhombus

The area of a rhombus is half the product of the lengths of its diagonals: Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂.

Properties of Rhombus

All four sides of a rhombus are equal in length, and opposite sides are parallel. Its diagonals bisect interior angles and are perpendicular bisectors of each other.
